payload.plan: AgentPlan(hypothesis='The intermittent timeouts are caused by a transient overload or resource contention in the checkout-service, possibly due to increased traffic or a recent deployment that introduced a performance regression.', steps=[PlanStep(step_id='S1', objective='Verify current health and metrics of checkout-service', success_signal='All health checks green and latency metrics within acceptable range', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S2', objective='Inspect recent deployments and configuration changes for checkout-service', success_signal='No recent changes that could affect performance', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S3', objective='Analyze traffic patterns and load during timeout incidents', success_signal='Identify any traffic spikes or unusual request patterns', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S4', objective='Check resource utilization (CPU, memory, I/O) on checkout-service instances', success_signal='Resource usage below thresholds', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S5', objective='Review logs for timeout errors and stack traces in checkout-service', success_signal='No unexpected exceptions or errors', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S6', objective='If resource contention detected, scale checkout-service horizontally or adjust autoscaling thresholds', success_signal='Latency metrics improve and p95 <=800ms', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S7', objective='If no resource issue, perform a rolling restart of checkout-service to clear stale state', success_signal='Checkout success rate >=99% and no new timeouts', status='pending'), PlanStep(step_id='S8', objective='Implement monitoring alerts for checkout-service latency and timeouts', success_signal='Alerts trigger before thresholds are breached', status='pending')], revision=1, rationale_summary='The alert correlation points to checkout-service, and the impact is on checkout completion rate. A recent deployment or traffic spike could have increased CPU/memory usage or caused lock contention, leading to timeouts. Objective metrics (p95 <=800ms) suggest latency issues.
